VERIFIED 2026-08-22 by driving: cp-023328 placed to 0.000500 m horizontal and +0.000883 m vertical, arrival verified, down from 0.710 m. These constants are for build 0F6DCAC1 / 1.4.1.3 ONLY.

History: the previous values were measured on 1AC2F605, where placements missed by ~0.57 m; on 0F6DCAC1 the same constants missed by ~0.71 m with the engine tunables byte-identical. Both misses were recorded as an 11.633 deg heading error and believed uncorrectable by calibration.

That was wrong. The engine's displacement from a written destination is a CONSTANT VECTOR in the vehicle frame, and the model had no term for its off-axis component, so half a metre of lateral miss had nowhere to go. Measured by placing with D deliberately doubled: the error moved by exactly -deltaD along the heading (0.2 mm agreement) and the lateral component did not move at all. Whether the engine gets there by rotating or translating is unobservable from outside and does not matter - no experiment can separate them, because the engine's own range is not something this tool can vary.

H is unchanged and was always correct. D and L are per track AND per vehicle AND PER BUILD - D moved between 1AC2F605 and 1.4.1.3 with the tunables identical, so re-measure both when the game patches. Do NOT reuse this file for 1AC2F605; it is now wrong for that build.
note: D and H are measured for THIS track and vehicle only. Never reuse them for another combination.
